result.reason: The revision satisfies the fallback by covering affiliates more favorably than the written-notice minimum and permitting transfer to an M&A successor. It also appropriately covers contractors and removes discretionary revocability without disturbing the licence’s purpose or economics. It does not fully achieve the preferred position because termination under Section 4 is not expressly limited to uncured material breach, and no perpetual treatment is stated for any paid-up licence.
